title: Official Codex Plugin for Claude Code
blurb: As of late March 2026, OpenAI ships an official plugin to trigger Codex directly from a Claude Code session.
body:
OpenAI now provides an official Codex Plugin for Claude Code that lets you trigger Codex directly from your Claude Code session — cross-vendor tooling in one terminal.

Install

  1. Ensure Codex CLI is installed: npm install -g @openai/codex
  2. Install the plugin: npm install -g @openai/codex-plugin-cc

Key slash commands

  • /codex:review — sends current changes to Codex for a standard code review
  • /codex:adversarial-review — a security-focused audit of the code
  • /codex:rescue — investigates and suggests fixes for persistent bugs
SOURCE · OpenAI Developer docs, surfaced via LinkedIn.
